title: MZ RPG Maker MZ Suikoden Weapon Upgrade Plugin

posts.author: Orbilis
posts.body:
Have just started learning RPG Maker MZ and decided to start learning plugins by building the Suikoden 1 Weapon Upgrade system. Haven't completed adding Rune pieces yet, but once that's completed, and I have cleaned up the code, I'll share it for anyone interested.
Once complete, the plugin should allow you to set a maximum upgrade level and stats for the weapons as they upgrade, alongside name and description changes at selected levels. I'm also looking to make all the windows' size, positioning and text customisable.
